tailoring.headline: E-Commerce Entwickler | SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) | Java & REST APIs
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering large-scale SAP Commerce Cloud platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong expertise in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, RESTful and OCC APIs, microservices, and data integration between PIM, ERP and MDM. Experienced in CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, SQL performance tuning, agile delivery and techno-functional consulting with business stakeholders.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Magento-Entwickler
cover_en.hook: I am excited about MACS HOLDING’s focus on innovative e-commerce solutions. With over five years delivering large-scale SAP Commerce Cloud platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in Java-based backend development, RESTful services and complex system integrations that align with the technical challenges of a Magento-Entwickler role.

bullets.label: Backend Development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented core backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java, Spring and Spring Boot, delivering robust product and catalog services.

bullets.label: API Design
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs, enabling seamless storefront and third-party integration.

bullets.label: Data Integration
bullets.text: Built PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines with Profisee, DataHub and Hotfolders, ensuring accurate product data synchronization across ERP and MDM systems.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Worked directly with business stakeholders to analyse requirements, write user stories and functional specifications, and translate them into scalable e-commerce solutions.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, holds a valid German work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026 and available to start 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your team.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Magento-Entwickler
cover_de.hook: Ich bin begeistert von MACS HOLDINGs Engagement für innovative E-Commerce-Lösungen. Mit über fünf Jahren Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von SAP Commerce Cloud Plattformen für Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich fundierte Kenntnisse in Java-Backend-Entwicklung, REST-Schnittstellen und komplexen Systemintegrationen mit, die exakt zu den Anforderungen eines Magento-Entwicklers passen.

bullets.label: Backend-Entwicklung
bullets.text: Entwarf und implementierte zentrale Backend-Funktionen auf SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) mit Java, Spring und Spring Boot und lieferte stabile Produkt- und Katalogservices.

bullets.label: API-Design
bullets.text: Entwickelte und stellte OCC-REST-Web-Services sowie Headless-APIs bereit, um nahtlose Storefront- und Drittanbieter-Integrationen zu ermöglichen.

bullets.label: Datenintegration
bullets.text: Erstellte PIM-zu-Hybris-Datenpipelines mit Profisee, DataHub und Hotfolders, um eine konsistente Produktdaten-Synchronisation über ERP- und MDM-Systeme sicherzustellen.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionale Beratung
bullets.text: Arbeitete eng mit Fachbereichen zusammen, analysierte Anforderungen, schrieb User-Stories und funktionale Spezifikationen und übersetzte sie in skalierbare E-Commerce-Lösungen.

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe, besitze eine gültige deutsche Arbeitserlaubnis, befinde mich in der Kündigungsfrist bis zum 15.12.2026 und kann ab dem 16.12.2026 starten. Ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch, um meinen Beitrag zu Ihrem Team zu erläutern.

tailoring.why_company: MACS HOLDING’s reputation for delivering cutting-edge, scalable e-commerce platforms aligns perfectly with my passion for building robust, API-driven solutions. I admire your commitment to leveraging modern architectures and continuous innovation, which offers the ideal environment for me to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise and drive high-performance online experiences for your clients.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to join MACS HOLDING to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud and integration expertise in a forward-thinking e-commerce team, delivering high-quality, scalable solutions that enhance customer experiences.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m interested in the Magento-Entwickler role at MACS HOLDING and would love to discuss how my backend and integration skills can add value to your team.
tailoring.email_body: Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Magento-Entwickler position. With over five years of experience delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong Java, Spring and REST API expertise, as well as proven integration and techno-functional consulting skills. I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit, and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit.
